text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese Citizen; 2. Age between 18 to 25 years old and in good health; 3. High School Diploma and Transcript (If you have not graduated at the time of application, you must provide a certificate of pre-graduation or expected graduation certificate.And than,obtain a high school diploma at the latest before enrolment); 4. Satisfy the language proficiency requirements for the Major speciality; 5. CSCA subjects requirements . 6. Comply with the regulations of the Ministry of Education’s document. [2020] No.12 and the relevant regulations of our university. ※High school graduates under 18 years of age, with a guardian in China (Dalian) can also apply. 7. English-Taught Program, requirement of English proficiency certificate as following ： (1) To submit a TOEFL or IELTS or Duolingo transcript, in principle, the TOEFL score must be 80 or higher, and the IELTS score must be 5.5 or higher, and the Duolingo score must be 100 or higher.; (2) the applicants that use English as the language of instruction at high school, may use the language certificate issued by the high school; (3) Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from proof of English language proficiency. If the applicant cannot provide the above proof,the final tutor and department could evaluate your language level according to the interview or written test.
